text:
ana.f: Quick ask  we just approved a band raise for an IC in Brazil, effective Feb 1. Signed packet arrived after cutoff. Do we run retro on next payroll or request an off-cycle?
people-ops: Short version: put the retro on the next scheduled payroll unless backdate > 90 days or local vendor (Paysys) insists on separate run. Brazil often needs FGTS/calc adjustments; confirm CPF and FGTS status.
nana.f: The packet has manager + gc approval, but comp-ops flagged that target equity % changed. Will that block payroll?
comp-ops: If equity target changes, comp-ops must approve grant paperwork before payroll applies any bonus/equity-related cash; salary retro can still proceed. Please don't attach equity award forms to the payroll intake email until comp-ops signs off.
lattice-bot: lattice-bot: Reminder  evidence must include timestamped approvals from mgr and mgrs mgr. Missing second approval delays intake.
nana.f: Great. What does payroll actually need from me in the email? Any preferred subject?
payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Use subject: "Retro Pay Request: [Last, First] - Brazil". Attach: signed packet PDF, Lattice link, CPF (or payroll ID), effective/backdate window, note if equity change = YES (and confirm comp-ops contact). If after cutoff, we'll queue for next run. Add header "BACKDATE" if >30 days.
people-ops: Also include whether FGTS contributions should be recomputed and whether any local taxes changed. For Brazil, vendor may recalc INSS/IRRF and that affects net retro.
nana.f: Thanks  I'll get comp-ops to sign the equity note and then send payroll with subject "Retro Pay Request: Santos, João - Brazil"
